svg.title: The epithelial barrier
svg.desc: An explanatory section of a polarised epithelial sheet. Its apical surface and microvilli are above the cell bodies; a goblet cell lies among columnar cells. Junctions lie between neighbouring cells, and a basement membrane separates the epithelial layer from the underlying connective tissue.

text.tspan: A continuous tissue section, from the lumen to the supporting tissue
Schematic; not to scale. Cell number and dimensions are illustrative. Anatomy reference: OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology
